_readme: Each slot is one photo on the site. Fill `src` with {"<width>": "<url>"} pairs (e.g. Pixieset's 500/1000/1500/2500 variants) and run `python3 tools/build.py`. Slots with an empty src render a labelled placeholder describing the intended shot.
